title: taraxacum taraxacoides f. gymnanthum
intro: Taraxacum taraxacoides f. gymnanthum, commonly known as the narrow-leaved dandelion, is a plant species in the dandelion genus. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The narrow-leaved dandelion has been found to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
